about: Andrew J. Bainbridge is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Columbus, Ohio area. Providing legal representation in Ohio for a variety of different issues, Andrew Bainbridge was selected to Super Lawyers for 2012 - 2023, 2025 - 2027.

After completing undergraduate studies, Andrew J. Bainbridge attended law school. Andrew Bainbridge was enrolled at The University of Toledo College of Law. He earned a juris doctor degree in 1996. Andrew Bainbridge was admitted to the practice of law in 1996.

Attorneys like Andrew J. Bainbridge are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Andrew Bainbridge represents clients with Workers' Compensation: Claimant issues. Additional legal issues represented include Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff and Social Security Disability.
